reasons: Four 4-MC courses (CS4211, CS2101, CS4221, CS4212) must fit in semesters 7-8, but the 4 MC per-semester limit allows only one course each semester.
CS4212 must be in semester 8 and CS4221 is only offered in Sem 2, but taking both together would be 8 MC, exceeding the 4 MC limit.
CS4211 must be in semester 7, leaving no room for CS2101 before semester 8.
